belief: God can't use me in this condition.
origins: Illness can erase roles in ministry, work, and family. When we cannot do what we used to do, we may feel set aside by God.
teaches: “God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.” “My power is perfected in weakness.” Moses said, “I have never been eloquent… I am slow of speech and tongue,” and God replied, “Who gave man his mouth?… Now go!” (Exodus 4:10–12). Gideon called his clan the weakest, and God said, “I will be with you.” Paul’s thorn became a platform for God’s power. God uses limited people because the power is His.
self_statements: I can’t do what I used to.
There is nothing I can offer.
errors: Believing God uses only the strong or no one.
Predicting that I will never serve again.
Feeling limited and concluding that I am unusable.
questions: What have I told myself God needs from me?
Whom did God use in Scripture who felt weak or limited?
What can I still do: pray, encourage, write, listen?
Who needs what I can give?
What does Scripture say about power in weakness?
What is one small service this week?
truth: God does not need my strength. He works through weak and limited people to display His power. I can serve in ways that fit my condition.
hw_truths: His power is perfected in weakness.
He will fulfill His purpose for me.
I can serve within my limits.
log: Each week, note one way you served.
actions: Write ways to serve within your limits.
prayer: Lord, I feel set aside. Show me how to serve within my limits, and display Your power in my weakness. Amen.
